description: Use this when you need to re-case text into a specific naming or letter case. Given `text` and a target `case` (upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, snake, kebab, or constant), returns the converted string. Smart word tokenization splits camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and whitespace, so a phrase in any style re-cases consistently; title case honors an editorial stop-word list and preserves ALL-CAPS acronyms. Empty text returns an empty result. Deterministic: same input, same output. Example: {text: "myVariableName", case: "constant"} -> result "MY_VARIABLE_NAME".

case.description: Target case: upper (UPPER CASE), lower (lower case), title (Title Case with stop-words), sentence (Sentence case), camel (camelCase), snake (snake_case), kebab (kebab-case), constant (CONSTANT_CASE).

name: convert_case

case.description: The target case that was applied (echoes the requested `case`).

result.description: The converted text. Empty string if the input text was empty.

title: Convert Case
